Profile: Shareable CodeSystem

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/research-study-registration-activity defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
record-verification Record VerificationRecord has been verified.
primary-outcome-data-collection Primary outcome data collectionThe data has been obtained for the primary outcomes from all participants.
registration-submission Registration submissionThe initial record has been submitted for registration.
registration-submission-qc Registration submission Quality CheckThe initial record submission has been confirmed to meet acceptance criteria for registration.
registration-posting Registration postingThe initial record has been registered and published.
results-submission Results submissionStudy results have been submitted.
results-submission-qc Results submission Quality CheckThe submitted study results have been confirmed to meet acceptance criteria for publication.
results-posting Results postingStudy results have been published in the registry.
disposition-submission Disposition submissionA request for deferral of study submission requirements has been submitted.
disposition-submission-qc Disposition submission Quality CheckThe submitted request for deferral of study submission requirements has been confirmed for acceptance for publication.
disposition-posting Disposition postingThe request for deferral of study submission requirements has been published in the registry.
update-submission Update submissionAn update to the record has been submitted.
update-posting Update postingAn update to the record has been published in the registry.

name: ResearchStudyRegistrationActivity

description: Codes for the stage in the progression of a therapy from initial experimental use in humans in clinical trials to post-market evaluation.
